summary: Regression test of Navbar.js login modal after making email+password inputs uncontrolled (defaultValue) and reading form.elements.username/password on submit for iCloud Passwords / Edge autofill support. All three test cases PASS.

tests_performed.name: Uncontrolled inputs retain typed values
tests_performed.details: Typed 'portal@pulsefitness.ltd' into auth-email-input and 'PulseFleet123!' into auth-password-input on /about page (Navbar rendered). input_value() confirmed values retained (email exact match, password length=14 matching typed 14 chars). name/autocomplete attributes verified: email name='username' autocomplete='username'; password name='password' autocomplete='current-password'.

tests_performed.name: Password show/hide toggle (password-toggle-btn) works on uncontrolled input
tests_performed.details: Input type transitions password -> text -> password across two clicks. Uncontrolled password value is preserved during toggle (defaultValue works with type switch).

tests_performed.name: Normal login succeeds with correct credentials
tests_performed.details: Submitting the form with portal@pulsefitness.ltd / PulseFleet123! authenticated successfully. A 'Choose Your Workspace' picker appeared (multi-workspace account); after clicking 'Operations Portal', the app navigated to /pulse and lite-dashboard test id rendered. 'Login successful' toast confirmed. NOTE: dashboard route is /pulse (not '/' as stated in review) — this is preexisting workspace routing, not related to the uncontrolled-input fix.

tests_performed.name: Wrong password shows error banner and does NOT navigate
tests_performed.details: Cleared cookies+storage, opened login modal again, submitted portal@pulsefitness.ltd with WrongPassword999!. Backend returned 401; UI showed 'Login failed / Invalid credentials' error banner; modal remained open; lite-dashboard not present. Submit validation and error UI both intact.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: DialogContent still emits Radix warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' for auth-dialog on Navbar.js. Not a functional bug but a11y warning in console.
Observation: the review request references route '/' for lite-dashboard, but after login the operations portal is at '/pulse'. Confirm expected route with product owner (unrelated to this fix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Navbar.js login modal is reached via routes that render <Navbar/> (e.g., /about, /contact, /features). The landing page ('/') uses a DIFFERENT modal from PulseLandingPage.js (testids pulse-login-email / pulse-login-password / pulse-login-submit) and was NOT part of this fix. If iCloud/Edge autofill needs to also work on the landing-page modal, that fix must be replicated in PulseLandingPage.js (currently still React controlled with value= binding).
rca of the issue: N/A — regression check only. Fix in Navbar.js verified: uncontrolled inputs (defaultValue) preserve typed values, name+autocomplete allow Edge/iCloud autofill detection, and handleAuth reads live DOM values via form.elements.username/password so autofilled values are used at submit time even if React state didn't sync.
